paragraphs.text: Baszerat is a small nation in southwestern Gulmany , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .
The capital of Baszerat is crescent-shaped.

Baszerat has a long-standing rivalry with the nearby country of Morvern . During the Thaw in 3245 AR , Phyrexian sleeper agents infiltrated Morvern and inflamed relations, causing the two countries to wage war against one another - the Morvernish against the Baszerati.
